$comment: Keeps project memory (documentation-maintainer's .ai/ notes) in play: SessionStart puts .ai/memory.md into context once per session, and PostToolUse reminds the agent to update docs after each edit. Move the SessionStart entry to UserPromptSubmit only if the file is short; it is then re-sent on every prompt.

hooks.command: python -c "import pathlib; p = pathlib.Path('.ai/memory.md'); print(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if p.exists() else None"

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"File changed. Before finishing this task, update what the change made stale: the why-comment at the change, the folder README, .ai/tasks.md and .ai/memory.md (documentation-maintainer)."}}'
